frontmatter_snapshot.summary: Bridging aggregate equity value to per-share value via the appropriate share count — basic vs diluted, with treasury-stock-method and if-converted-method adjustments for options, warrants, and convertibles. The forward-looking share-count adjustment reflects expected issuance for stock-based comp and acquisitions net of expected buybacks.
